text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. A well-balanced blend of umami and 
astringency. Would this be from Uji, 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, then for this blind tea 
tasting: these are the pairings of the 
served teas and their origins!

text_block_list.name: Tea Party Host
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, splendid! To think you 
could guess all five combination sets 
correctly.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah! Tea is an essential art for a 
warrior, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason attended the tea party and 
seemed to enjoy a fulfilling day off.
